item: assertionFailure on an unsupported style is fatal on Windows and silent on Linux
note: P11 asked for .datePickerStyle(.compact); GtkBackend supports only [.automatic .graphical] and DatePickerStyleModifier calls assertionFailure before falling back. Assertions trap in debug and vanish in release, and this project builds debug on Windows and release on Linux — so the same code on the same backend was fatal on one platform only. Fixed in P11 by reading Environment supportedDatePickerStyles first
